result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and commercial land use suggest a high-volume traffic environment that could be improved with traffic calming measures.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a median refuge, increasing exposure time to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main road

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No visible pedestrian-specific signal heads to indicate when it is safe to cross at this signalized intersection.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and signage near the corner may block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side near the commercial parking lot entrance

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility at the corners.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment includes a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides of a mixed-use street. However, the crossing is wide and lacks a refuge island or signalization, while parked vehicles on the right create significant sightline obstructions.

hazards.name: Parked vehicles near crosswalk
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide uncontrolled crossing
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires a long crossing distance without the protection of a signal or median.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Extending the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Providing a safe waiting area in the middle of the street.

result.summary: This signalized intersection on a one-way street lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the environment is heavily oriented toward vehicle throughput with significant sightline obstructions from parked cars.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at this signalized intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected path.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks walk/don't-walk signals, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signal timing which may not include adequate clearance intervals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the intersection corners block the view between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style high-visibility crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to improve safety and predictability for people crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and prevent cars from parking too close to the intersection, improving visibility.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks, curb ramps with tactile paving, and a painted curb extension with delineators to reduce crossing distance. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of visible pedestrian signals and the width of the roadway increase exposure risk for people crossing.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible at this signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Permanent Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Replace the painted buffer and flex posts with permanent concrete curb extensions to further shorten crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before parallel vehicle traffic receives a green light.
